login.title: Sign in to Multica
login.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a verification code.
login.send_failed: Couldn't send the sign-in code. Try again.

verify.title: Enter your code
verify.invalid_code: That code isn't valid or has expired.
verify.expired: That code has expired. Tap resend to get a new one.
verify.mismatch: That code didn't match. Double-check and try again.
verify.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
verify.network: Can't reach Multica. Check your connection and retry.
verify.send_failed: Couldn't send the code. Try again.
verify.verify_failed: Couldn't verify the code. Try again.
verify.resend_failed: Couldn't resend the code. Try again.
verify.paste_a11y: Paste the code from the clipboard
verify.paste_none: No 6-digit code found in the clipboard.

server.title: Server connection
server.subtitle: Connect this phone to Tailscale, then enter your Multica server’s HTTPS address.
server.test_not_multica: The address answered, but not like a Multica server.
server.test_failed: Could not reach Multica ({{reason}}). Check that Tailscale is connected and the address and port are correct.
server.change_warning: Changing the server signs you out on this phone.
server.forget_confirm_body: The server address and Multica session will be removed from this phone.
server.error_url_invalid: That is not a valid URL.
server.not_configured: No server configured. Open server settings first.
server.clear_clipboard_hint: Clears the system clipboard. No app can clear the keyboard's clipboard history (e.g. Gboard) – copy from a password manager that auto-clears.
server.paste_secret_rejected: A service secret was pasted. The clipboard was cleared.
server.paste_not_token: That is a Cloudflare secret, not a login token. The clipboard was cleared.
server.test_redirected: The server redirected the request. Enter the final HTTPS address that serves Multica.
server.save_failed: Could not save the server settings.
server.error_url_tailnet: Enter the full Tailscale hostname ending in .ts.net.
